messages:
incident-bot: Incident #2026-43 postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-43. Follow-ups include customer-facing note + RCA sharing decision.

maria_comms: Thanks — can we lock down the statuspage blurb before we send outreach? need a one-paragraph summary we can use across channels.

devon_sre: I can draft. Proposal (short):

```
Summary: We experienced increased 5xx errors impacting API requests between 03:20–03:44 UTC. Services degraded briefly; traffic rerouted and retries mitigated most errors. Root cause: autoscaling gap during a spike; fix: adjust autoscaler and add guardrails. Customers may have seen transient errors; we are monitoring. More details & timeline: link to RCAs.
```

maria_comms: 👍 cleaner. Can we remove the internal terms like "autoscaling gap" and instead say "scaling delay" for customer-facing text?

devon_sre: yep. updated snippet:

```
Summary: We experienced increased 5xx errors impacting API requests between 03:20–03:44 UTC. Services briefly degraded during a scaling delay; automated retries reduced impact. We have deployed a fix to prevent recurrence and are monitoring closely. Full incident timeline and RCA are available.
```

emma_dev: For the customer note, three decisions we need:
1) statuspage blurb (devon has a draft)
2) short external timeline (editable bullets)
3) whether to attach full RCA or share on request (redaction policy)

raj_ops: My recommendation: publish the blurb + short timeline publicly; do NOT attach the full technical RCA. Offer to share the full RCA to customers who request it after a redaction review (legal + security). This avoids accidental exposure of sensitive internal details.

maria_comms: Agree. Suggest wording for timeline (2–3 bullets):
- 03:20 — first increase in error rate detected
- 03:28 — mitigation (traffic routing + retries) in place
- 03:44 — normal traffic resumed; monitoring continues

maria_comms: Who will own the customer outreach email? I can draft but need a technical sign-off person.

devon_sre: I can sign off on technical accuracy. assign owners?

maria_comms: Proposed owners and deadlines:
- Draft outreach copy: maria_comms — due +1 business day (2358001234 -> EOD +1)
- Tech sign-off on copy: devon_sre — due within 4 hours of draft
- Redaction review for RCA: legal_team (cc: security) — due +3 business days
- Publish statuspage + short timeline: product_ops — coordinated with comms

devon_sre: I'll handle the sign-off. Can we set a hard deadline for redaction so we don't leave customers waiting? legal_team: can you confirm availability?

legal_team: we can do a triage review within 72 hours; if customer requests earlier we can prioritize on request.

emma_dev: Also flagging recurring pattern detection: this is the 3rd spike with similar characteristics in 90 days. We should schedule a recurring-incident pattern review and own it.

raj_ops: Good catch. Action: create pattern ticket in postmortem tracker and assign to "recurring-incidents" squad. Owner: raj_ops; due +7 days.

emma_dev: Quick query to verify frequency (Sentinel logs):
```
service:api AND status_code>=500 | timeseries(count(), by=day, last=90d)
```

raj_ops: I'll add the query to the tracker. Also added note to correlate with deployment windows.

maria_comms: For customer-facing language on RCA sharing I'm drafting this line:
"A full incident report with technical details can be provided on request after a brief review to remove operationally sensitive information."

devon_sre: That reads well. Add: "If you are impacted and want the full report, please reply to this message or contact support@redwood.com".

maria_comms: Added. Final checklist before sending:
- [ ] Draft outreach copy (maria_comms)
- [ ] Technical sign-off (devon_sre)
- [ ] Legal redaction window communicated (legal_team)
- [ ] Publish statuspage blurb (product_ops)
- [ ] Create recurring-incident ticket & owner (raj_ops)
- [ ] Add monitoring alert tweaks + autoscaler config PR (emma_dev)

devon_sre: I'll open the autoscaler PR later today and link the PR in the tracker.
maria_comms: I'll post the outreach draft in #customer-outreach for review once done. pinging @here when ready.

incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 72 hours (2358003954).

raj_ops: Noting action owners in the postmortem tracker now. I'll reach out to legal_team for the redaction SLA.
maria_comms: Thanks everyone — will follow up here with the draft. 🙏

devon_sre: +1 — thanks. Closing loop once published.
